Owner Emaillauran.serhal@oracle.com
Owner GroupDB Product Management
Short DescriptionWith Oracle Autonomous AI Lakehouse, customers can build Data Lakes from scratch or by augmenting existing data warehouse implementations. Data Lakes help customers who want to maximize business output from their data capital. Oracle proudly offers a wide range of database features to help customers to implement the all-data strategy.
Long DescriptionData is everywhere stored both locally and on the cloud in different format such as CSV, Parquet, JSON, ORC, Avro, and the new table format that will be available soon such as Iceberg and Delta Share. Although the metadata can stored in different places, Autonomous AI Lakehouse can work with it whether it is stored locally (using PL/SQL,API, and the UI) or in central places in data catalogs (such as OCI DCAT and AWS Glue). AI Lakehouse provides high performance when querying external data at scale. Finally, AI Lakehouse provides multi-language support to process Data Lakes such as SQL, Python, R, and REST. The labs in this workshop walk you through all the steps that you need to build and access the Data Lake (Oracle Object Storage buckets) using Autonomous AI Lakehouse. First, you set-up the workshop environment and create the necessary resources such as a compartment, an Autonomous AI Lakehouse instance, and Oracle Object Storage resources. Next, evolve object storage files into meaningful business entities by defining the metadata for external data in AI Lakehouse using several methods such as programmatically using PL/SQL scripts, using the Database Actions user interface, or by synchronizing with Data Catalogs (to derive the metadata) such as OCI Data Catalog and AWS Glue. Next, you can gain insights from Data Lakes by querying data that lives in your Oracle AI Lakehouse and combine that with data that is stored in your Oracle Object Storage buckets using regular SQL select statements that includes joined tables. You also move data to Object Storage buckets by exporting your datasets. Finally, you query your data using the SQL Worksheet.

Long DescriptionThis workshop presents a practical approach to upgrading databases to Oracle AI Database 26ai. Short DescriptionExperience the new Select AI Agent feature on Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Using the DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT package, learn how to use this simple framework to build, deploy, and manage AI agents. Build custom tools using PL/SQL. Invoke external tools using REST. Leverage pre-built tools for RAG and NL2SQL.
Long DescriptionThere are many agentic AI frameworks, but only one is built into your database: Select AI Agent. Autonomous AI Database introduces the DBMS_CLOUD_AI_AGENT package, which provides a simple framework to build, deploy, and manage AI agents. Build custom tools using PL/SQL. Invoke external tools using REST. Leverage pre-built tools for RAG and NL2SQL. And do this with multi-turn chat conversations, context retention, and auto-scaling. In this workshop, learn about agentic AI and how to build tools, tasks, and agents to support common use cases.

Short DescriptionExplore OCI Vision within the AI Service group to perform tasks like image classification, object detection, text detection, document AI etc., with a few simple steps.
Long DescriptionEnterprise image and document data has significant value related to core business activities and their customers. To gain business and customer insights effectively and at scale from this data, vision capabilities are needed. For example, identifying key requirements to understand customer perception of their products to address gaps. Some core capabilities include classifying images & documents, detecting objects, text & languages and extracting table information from the data. These capabilities are typically machine learning algorithms custom built, tuned by Data Scientists and productized for use in applications. Doing this is a time consuming and expensive proposition. OCI Vision Service reduces time and effort to perform Vision tasks like image classification, object detection, text detection, document AI etc by providing key vision capabilities via production-ready REST APIs. The service enables applications to automate sophisticated image and document analysis at scale without needing ML expertise. The service functionality is implemented with pre-trained ML models which are often useful. They may also be further customized to understand the patterns of the customer’s context by providing additional data.

Short DescriptionThis workshop will go through the basic steps of getting started with AI Vector search, including why AI Vector Search is so important and how to use AI Vector Search in applications.
Long DescriptionThis workshop will cover what AI Vector Search is and how it works. Included will be hands on exercises to: - introduce similarity search - add the new vector datatype - verify ONNX embedding models - create vector embeddings for text and images - perform exact similarity searches - create vector indexes and run approximate similarity searches - combine similarity searches with normal relational queries - use the data and queries defined in the lab to see how similarity search works in a pre-built APEX application - learn how AI Vector Search can augment RAG queries and see a pre-built APEX chatbot works using AI Vector Search and RAG

Short DescriptionIn this workshop, you’ll have the opportunity to experiment with predictive models and choose which variables you think will determine a successful pit stop. You’ll also learn about the steps of creating a machine learning model to try and predict the best pit strategy for a team, become familiar with the entire process, and discover how to tie data science results back to the business.
Long DescriptionExplore data, deploy a predictive machine learning model … and win a simulated Red Bull Race against your peers. You’re the race strategist at Red Bull Racing. Your mission? The night before the race, you’ll have to use machine learning to predict which factors contribute to determining the fastest race. But there are multiple factors that go into predicting the fastest race, including different tire compounds, qualifying performance, historical data on which laps are chosen for pit stops, and expected weather conditions. What are the variables that make all the difference? In this two-hour workshop, you’ll have the opportunity to experiment with predictive models and choose which variables you think will determine a successful pit stop. You’ll also learn about the steps of creating a machine learning model to try and predict the best pit strategy for a team, become familiar with the entire process, and discover how to tie data science results back to the business.

Long DescriptionLearn how to share live data with Cloud Links using PL/SQL in Oracle Autonomous AI Database. Short DescriptionPython is a major programming language used for data science and machine learning. OML4Py is a new feature on Autonomous AI Database that provides Python users access to powerful in-database functionality supporting data scientists. It is essential Oracle provide adequate training content to introduce users to this technology.
Long DescriptionIn this hands-on lab, experience Oracle Machine Learning for Python on Oracle Autonomous AI Database. OML4Py supports scalable in-database data exploration and preparation using native Python syntax, invocation of in-database algorithms for model building and scoring, and embedded execution of user-defined Python functions from Python or REST APIs. OML4Py also includes the AutoML interface for automated algorithms and feature selection, and hyperparameter tuning. Join us for this tour of OML4Py.

Short DescriptionBuild real-world GenAI apps in this hands-on workshop using Oracle AI Database and OCI Generative AI. Write Python with JSON Relational Duality Views, enable AI Vector Search, and build a RAG-enabled app. Explore Oracle MCP Server and build agentic apps, run a custom MCP server, call MCP tools, and register your own MCP tool.
Long DescriptionIf you’ve been itching to build real-world AI apps—beyond demos—this hands-on workshop is for you. For data engineers, app developers, and solution architects, we’ll build practical, industry-focused GenAI applications with Oracle AI Database. You’ll write Python to manage data with JSON Relational Duality Views and deliver smarter search via AI Vector Search. You’ll plug in OCI Generative AI services to build a RAG-enabled web app. You’ll also dive into the Model Context Platform (MCP), learning how it wires tools into agent workflows. First, you’ll learn how to use a Oracle MCP server to implement agentic workflows and explore a sample agentic application. Then, you’ll run a custom MCP server that connects to Oracle AI Database and OCI Generative AI, call MCP tools, and implement and register your own MCP tool.

Owner Emaillavkesh.singh@oracle.com
Short DescriptionThis workshop turns a step-by-step implementation blog into a guided LiveLabs flow. You will publish an Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory agent, inspect the integration endpoint, understand the session-cookie requirement, bridge the private backend with OCI API Gateway, and wire Oracle APEX PL/SQL to start and continue agent conversations without manual cookie handling.
Long DescriptionThis LiveLabs workshop walks learners through the complete end-to-end process of connecting Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory (PAF) to Oracle APEX using OCI API Gateway, APEX Web Credentials, and PL/SQL. Learners begin by publishing a working agent in Agent Factory, capturing the integration endpoint, and understanding the two core challenges in the integration: the browser-based session cookie required by PAF and the private-network, self-signed SSL setup that prevents a straightforward direct call from APEX. The workshop then shows how OCI API Gateway can be configured as the bridge between APEX and the private backend, including the required login and agent routes and the SSL verification settings needed for this pattern to work. After the gateway is in place, learners move into Oracle APEX and implement the full server-side integration flow. They create secure Web Credentials for storing login information, build PL/SQL logic to fetch a fresh agent_factory_session cookie automatically, initialize a room for the conversation, and send user messages to the published agent through the gateway. They also learn how to parse NDJSON responses returned by the service and return those responses cleanly back into the APEX application. By the end of the workshop, participants will have a practical, production-oriented blueprint for integrating Oracle Agent Factory with Oracle APEX without relying on manual cookie copy-paste steps, while also understanding the architectural decisions, security considerations, and operational flow behind the solution. The workshop concludes with a knowledge-check lab to reinforce the concepts and implementation details.

Short DescriptionBuild AI agents that remember. Learn to create database-powered agents with persistent memory, semantic search, and enterprise data access using Oracle Select AI Agent framework. Hands-on with SQL.
Long DescriptionMost AI systems can answer questions. AI agents are built to do work. In this hands-on workshop, you will build AI agents for a financial services company called Seer Equity. Their current systems cannot answer simple questions like loan status or pending applications. Instead of returning results, they explain how to look things up. That breaks trust and frustrates clients. You will build AI agents that connect directly to a loan database and return real answers. When asked about a loan, the agent queries data and responds with the current status, amount, and owner. You will see exactly what the agent did and why it did it. During the workshop, you will: Build AI agents that act on data instead of explaining steps Store and recall client information across interactions Use prior decisions to guide new ones Apply company policies stored in the database Record every action for audit and compliance You will use Oracle Database and the Select AI Agent framework to define tools, agents, tasks, and teams using SQL. By the end, you will have a working loan processing system built around AI agents that behave consistently and can be trusted. No machine learning background required. Just SQL and curiosity.

You’ll develop a few scenarios both from the user's and the administrator's perspective.

Short DescriptionBuild a dynamic application using Oracle APEX AI Assistant using the sample project management dataset.
Long DescriptionIn this lab, you will build a dynamic application using Oracle APEX AI Assistant. You will start by installing a sample project management dataset, then create an initial application with the help of an AI Assistant, demonstrating how AI can accelerate development. Next, you will customize your application the lowcode way, making quick adjustments using pre-built components. You will also enhance your application by writing SQL queries with APEX Assistant, simplifying complex query construction. Finally, you will implement an AI chat assistant using Dynamic Actions and Chat Widget, creating a responsive chat interface for real-time user engagement. By the end of this lab, you'll have practical knowledge in using AI with APEX to efficiently build and customize powerful applications.

Long DescriptionThis workshop introduces key graph data modeling and analysis concepts and the interactive Graph Studio for working with graphs in an Autonomous AI Database. Oracle Autonomous AI Database contains features that enable it to function as a scalable property graph database. They automate the creation of graph models and in-memory graphs from database tables. Short DescriptionAutomate the synchronization of Oracle Services Network (OSN) public IP ranges to a Palo Alto firewall using OCI Functions, helping security teams keep firewall address objects aligned with Oracle service CIDRs.
Long DescriptionModern cloud environments often require firewall policies to allow access to Oracle services while maintaining strict traffic control and visibility. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) publishes public IP address ranges in JSON format, including ranges associated with the Oracle Services Network (OSN). Manually tracking these ranges and updating firewall objects can be time-consuming, error-prone, and difficult to maintain at scale. This workshop demonstrates how to automate the synchronization of OSN public IP ranges to a Palo Alto firewall deployed in an OCI Hub VCN using OCI Functions. The solution retrieves the OCI public IP ranges JSON, filters the required service ranges by region and service tag, and updates Palo Alto address objects and address groups through the firewall API.

Short DescriptionExplore migrating On-Premises Oracle Database to the Oracle ADB using ZDM Logical Online methodology
Long DescriptionOracle customers are moving Oracle workloads into the Oracle Cloud or onto Engineered Systems at a growingly rapid pace. However, migrating workloads has been a source of challenges for many years. In particular, migrating database workloads from one system to another or into the Cloud is easier said than done. Based on years of experience migrating Oracle workloads, Oracle has developed Zero Downtime Migration (ZDM). ZDM is Oracle’s premier solution for a simplified and automated migration experience, providing zero to negligible downtime for the production system and depending on the migration scenario. ZDM allows you to directly and seamlessly migrate your on-premises Oracle Databases to and between any Oracle-owned infrastructure, including Exadata Database Machine On-Premises, Exadata Cloud at Customer (ExaC@C), and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. This workshop covers an in-depth step-by-step guide of migrating your On-Premises Oracle Databases to the Oracle Autonomous Database using ZDM's Logical Online methodology.

Short DescriptionBuild AI agents that remember. Learn to create database-powered agents with persistent memory, semantic search, and enterprise data access using Oracle Select AI Agent framework. Hands-on with SQL.
Long DescriptionMost AI systems can answer questions. AI agents are built to do work. In this hands-on workshop, you will build AI agents for a financial services company called Seer Equity. Their current systems cannot answer simple questions like loan status or pending applications. Instead of returning results, they explain how to look things up. That breaks trust and frustrates clients. You will build AI agents that connect directly to a loan database and return real answers. When asked about a loan, the agent queries data and responds with the current status, amount, and owner. You will see exactly what the agent did and why it did it. During the workshop, you will: Build AI agents that act on data instead of explaining steps Store and recall client information across interactions Use prior decisions to guide new ones Apply company policies stored in the database Record every action for audit and compliance You will use Oracle Database and the Select AI Agent framework to define tools, agents, tasks, and teams using SQL. By the end, you will have a working loan processing system built around AI agents that behave consistently and can be trusted. No machine learning background required. Just SQL and curiosity.

Short DescriptionThis workshop will help you get started with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI). You will explore ODI using detailed examples to help you learn how to use Oracle Data Integrator to solve business problems.
Long DescriptionOracle Data Integrator (ODI) is a comprehensive data integration platform that covers all data integration requirements: from high-volume, high-performance batch loads, to event-driven, trickle-feed integration processes, to SOA-enabled data services. Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) 12c, the latest version of Oracle’s strategic Data Integration offering, provides superior developer productivity and improved user experience with a redesigned flow-based declarative user interface and deeper integration with Oracle GoldenGate. ODI12c further builds on its flexible and high-performance architecture with comprehensive big data support and added parallelism when executing data integration processes. It includes interoperability with Oracle Warehouse Builder (OWB) for a quick and simple migration for OWB customers to ODI12c. Additionally, ODI can be monitored from a single solution along with other Oracle technologies and applications through the integration with Oracle Enterprise Manager 12c.

Short DescriptionIf you are passionate about football and data, this live hands-on-lab is for you! Thanks to our partnership with Premier League you have the unique opportunity to experience first-hand what it is to be a football analyst and apply advanced analytics and machine learning to real match data!
Long DescriptionIf you are passionate about football and data, this live hands-on-lab is for you! Thanks to our partnership with Premier League you have the unique opportunity to experience first-hand what it is to be a football analyst and apply advanced analytics and machine learning to real match data! Expected goals (xG) is a predictive model used to assess every goal-scoring chance, and the likelihood of scoring. The xG model computes for each chance, the probability to score based on factors such as distance, position of defenders, type and speed of pass, type of shot, shot angles and various other aspects (Event-based variables). You will prepare match data on Autonomous to make it ready for analysis, visualize data on a football pitch, train your own xG machine learning model and apply your model to recent matches to understand team and player performance.

Owner GroupDB Product Management
Short DescriptionBuild AI agents that remember. Learn to create database-powered agents with persistent memory, semantic search, and enterprise data access using Oracle Select AI Agent framework. Hands-on with SQL.
Long DescriptionMost AI systems can answer questions. AI agents are built to do work. In this hands-on workshop, you will build AI agents for a financial services company called Seer Equity. Their current systems cannot answer simple questions like loan status or pending applications. Instead of returning results, they explain how to look things up. That breaks trust and frustrates clients. You will build AI agents that connect directly to a loan database and return real answers. When asked about a loan, the agent queries data and responds with the current status, amount, and owner. You will see exactly what the agent did and why it did it. During the workshop, you will: Build AI agents that act on data instead of explaining steps Store and recall client information across interactions Use prior decisions to guide new ones Apply company policies stored in the database Record every action for audit and compliance You will use Oracle Database and the Select AI Agent framework to define tools, agents, tasks, and teams using SQL. By the end, you will have a working loan processing system built around AI agents that behave consistently and can be trusted. No machine learning background required. Just SQL and curiosity.

Short DescriptionUse Oracle AI Database plus Oracle Private AI Container to build a multimodal image search app!
Long DescriptionIn this workshop, you build a private vector-search stack in from end to end. You verify runtime services, run two embedding paths, and learn when each one fits best: in-database ONNX for SQL-first simplicity, and Oracle Private AI Services Container for flexible model serving. You generate embeddings, store vectors in Oracle AI Database 26ai, and rank semantic matches with cosine similarity in SQL. You then build a image-search app that uses CLIP text and image embeddings to return the top matches from the database. You finish with working notebooks and practical app code for secure, local embedding generation and retrieval.

Short DescriptionThis expense agent showcases an intelligent end-to-end automation flow that converts receipt images into validated expense entries with minimal manual effort. Using AI for data extraction, classification, and policy evaluation — with optional human approval when required — the process is orchestrated through Oracle Integration.
Long DescriptionThis expense agent use case demonstrates an intelligent, end-to-end automation flow that transforms raw expense receipts into validated expense records with minimal manual intervention. The agent reads receipt images from a file server and sends them to OCI Document Understanding for structured data extraction, while OCI GenAI assists in classifying the expense type with contextual accuracy. A decision service evaluates policy rules to determine whether approval is required; when explicit authorization is needed, a human-in-the-loop (HITL) step is triggered to maintain governance and compliance. Once validated, the agent creates the expense entry in Oracle HCM Cloud. The entire process is orchestrated through Oracle Integration, where an agent built using a ReAct-style pattern dynamically invokes the appropriate tools based on defined guidelines. This architecture combines AI-driven insight, rule-based decisioning, and enterprise workflow orchestration to deliver a scalable, auditable, and intelligent expense processing experience.

Short DescriptionJumpstart your journey into modern data engineering and analytics on Oracle Cloud. Long DescriptionUnlock the power of Oracle’s next-generation analytics ecosystem in this hands-on workshop designed for new data professionals and cloud practitioners. You’ll explore the “lakehouse” paradigm by working with real airline operations data, learning to ingest, transform, and analyze large-scale datasets using Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP). You’ll build an end-to-end pipeline—loading raw data into the cloud, performing scalable cleansing and enrichment with Spark and Delta Lake in AIDP, serving curated analytics in Autonomous AI Data Lakehouse (ADL), and discovering actionable insights through interactive dashboards in Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC). This session requires no prior cloud experience and leaves you prepared to accelerate analytics projects using Oracle’s robust Lakehouse patterns. Key takeaways: Understand the basics of the lakehouse architecture in Oracle Cloud. Build and deploy ETL pipelines in AIDP using Spark and Delta Lake. Prepare and analyze data in Autonomous AI Data Lakehouse. Create visual dashboards and reports using Oracle Analytics Cloud. Experience hands-on, end-to-end data flow—from raw files to business-ready insights. No prior experience with Spark or Oracle Cloud required—just curiosity and readiness to learn!

Short DescriptionThis workshop demonstrates how to integrate Oracle APEX with OCI Generative AI Agents, showcasing how enterprises can enhance their applications with intelligent, context-aware capabilities. You will explore the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) combined with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to transform raw enterprise documents into actionable insights.
Long DescriptionThis workshop demonstrates how to integrate Oracle APEX with OCI Generative AI Agents, showcasing how enterprises can enhance their applications with intelligent, context-aware capabilities. You will explore the power of Large Language Models (LLMs) combined with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to transform raw enterprise documents into actionable insights. As part of this workshop, you will begin by uploading various documents to OCI Object Storage, which serves as a secure, scalable repository for your enterprise data. These documents are then processed through an ingestion job, which parses, indexes, and prepares the data for interaction using the OCI Generative AI service. You will integrate a chat interface within your Oracle APEX application, allowing end users to interact with the Generative AI Agent in real time. The AI agent uses the previously ingested content to provide intelligent, personalized, and context-rich responses, enhancing user experience and driving operational efficiency.

Short DescriptionA simple hands-on workshop that can be executed in 90 minutes. It consists of a basic example of AI Vector Search and the integration with OCI Generative AI service for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) execution. It uses either an Oracle Autonomous AI Database 26ai free tier or a paid account. You can test any SQL statements and PL/SQL code in APEX tools and SQL Developer Web.
Long DescriptionRetrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is a relatively new artificial intelligence technique that can improve the quality of OCI Generative AI service by allowing large language models (LLMs) to tap into additional data sources without retraining. AI Vector Search enables searching both structured and unstructured data by semantics or meaning and values, enabling ultra-sophisticated AI search applications. This simple hands-on workshop can be executed in 90 minutes and consists of a basic example of AI Vector Search and the integration with OCI Generative AI service for RAG execution. It runs on Oracle Autonomous AI Database 26ai free tier or paid account. You can test any SQL statements and PL/SQL code in APEX tools and SQL Developer Web. You will learn how to run OCR on scanned documents and images containing text graphics to extract data for the embeddings. Besides PDF and Word documents, you can use JSON documents, such as GeoJSON shapes with geographical spatial information, which can be edited from the APEX demo application's GUI.

Owner Emailallen.hosler@oracle.com
Owner GroupDB Product Management - PTS
Short DescriptionLearn to build accurate, secure natural-language interfaces with Oracle Trusted Answer Search. This lab covers installing the platform, configuring search targets using AI Vector Search, and embedding the search widget into web applications to deliver deterministic, data-driven outcomes without the risks and "guesswork" of generic chatbots.
Long DescriptionEnterprises increasingly demand natural-language interfaces, but traditional LLM-based "chatbots" often introduce unacceptable risks regarding accuracy, predictability, and data security. Oracle Trusted Answer Search addresses these challenges by providing a purpose-built "language-to-report" mapping system. In this workshop, you will go hands-on with the primary components of the platform. You will start by deploying the core APEX-based administration and portal tools on the Oracle AI Database 26ai, leveraging its native AI Vector Search capabilities to match user queries to vetted business reports. You will then step into the role of a Search Admin to curate the user experience. You will learn how to define Search Targets associated with specific match documents (JSON), ensuring that your application responds with deterministic actions—like opening a precise URL—rather than generated (and potentially hallucinatory) text. The lab also covers advanced configuration, such as parameter extraction, which allows your search interface to identify specific values like "checking account" or "last Monday" to automatically filter the reports presented to the user. Finally, you will explore the developer experience by integrating the provided Javascript widget into a web application and the admin workflow for continuous improvement. You will learn how to use query history and user feedback (upvotes/downvotes) to refine search accuracy and use built-in regression analysis to safely manage changes to your search domain. By the end of this lab, you will have a fully functional, secure, and highly accurate natural-language search service.

Short DescriptionUsing LangChain and Python you will build a RAG application with Oracle AI Vector Search and your choice of LLMs.
Long DescriptionRetrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) is an important component in Generative AI. Here are three reasons why RAG should be included in your Gen AI application. 1. LLMs can hallucinate or generate incorrect responses to your prompt if it has not been trained to respond to the query in the prompt. Retraining LLMs to produce the responses you want can be very expensive. 2. Businesses and enterprises have lots of private and confidential information and they want to leverage the power of Gen AI with LLMs with the least cost. 3. Businesses and enterprises have streaming data and need LLM responses to this data in near real time. And that’s where RAG comes in. RAG allows important context to be included with the prompt to the LLM. In this workshop you will provide context and store that information in the form of vectors in Oracle Database 23ai, and use the Oracle AI Vector Search capability to return the context to augment LLM responses. You will use the popular LangChain framework to build the RAG application.

Short DescriptionMonitor and safeguard databases with real-time activity tracking, advanced threat detection, and Database Security Posture Management (DSPM). Ensure continuous protection of sensitive data, detect risks early, enforce access controls, and help organizations stay compliant and secure against evolving threats.
Long DescriptionIn the era of digital transformation and heightened regulatory expectations, data security is no longer optional—it is a vital necessity. Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) is a robust solution that empowers organizations to safeguard their most valuable digital assets from both internal and external threats. With AVDF, your databases are protected through advanced auditing, real-time monitoring, and proactive defense mechanisms, all managed from a unified, streamlined interface. Why Attend this LiveLab? Do you worry about meeting complex compliance mandates such as PCI DSS, SOX, or GDPR? Are you tasked with defending your organization against sophisticated cyber threats while enabling business agility? This hands-on LiveLab is the perfect environment for data professionals, security administrators, and auditors to experience first-hand how AVDF helps organizations secure sensitive information, streamline compliance, and respond rapidly to suspicious activity—before damage is done. What Problem Does AVDF Solve? Modern database environments are highly dynamic and increasingly targeted by cyber attackers. Insiders with privileged access often represent the greatest risk, whether through error or deliberate misuse. Traditional logging and monitoring solutions frequently fall short—missing subtle policy violations or producing overwhelming volumes of raw data that are hard to interpret and act upon. Furthermore, regulatory auditors demand immediate, centralized, and immutable proof of how sensitive data is accessed and who is responsible. AVDF bridges these gaps by: - Centralizing and automating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of audit data from Oracle and non-Oracle databases. - Delivering real-time monitoring and alerts to detect unusual or unauthorized SQL activity—down to the individual statement. - Enforcing fine-grained controls at the network edge with the Database Firewall, blocking unwanted or suspicious commands before they can cause harm. - Offering a rich suite of compliance-ready reports and dashboards for continuous assurance. What You’ll Experience in this LiveLab In this interactive session, you'll step into the shoes of a security analyst or compliance officer as you: - Deploy and configure AVDF for both Oracle and non-Oracle database environments - Set up real-time auditing policies and analyze collected data through intuitive dashboards - Use the Database Firewall to enforce strong security controls, detect policy violations, and block malicious SQL traffic - Respond to simulated threats, generate compliance reports, and implement best practices for the separation of duties With guided exercises and real-world scenarios, you’ll gain practical skills you can immediately apply to your organization’s security and compliance strategy. No prior AVDF experience is required—just a willingness to learn and a desire to witness the power of Oracle’s database security solutions. Who Should Attend? - Database Administrators - Security Engineers - Auditors and Compliance Officers - IT Managers and Risk Professionals Whether you are wrestling with stricter compliance mandates, tightening your security posture, or just curious about next-generation database protection, this LiveLab will inspire you to rethink what’s possible with AVDF. Take the next step in your data security journey—join us for the AVDF LiveLab and unlock the tools to secure your enterprise database estates, meet compliance demands with confidence, and fend off the threats of tomorrow. Your path to resilient database defense starts here.

Long Description- Build an intelligent Clinical Quality Assessment Agent that automates patient utilization reviews—evaluating medical necessity, ensuring guideline compliance, and identifying clinical improvement opportunities - Master Agentic AI fundamentals: Learn how AI agents use Large Language Models to reason adaptively and orchestrate multiple integrations based on clinical context, unlike traditional fixed workflows - Work with a healthcare use case featuring five specialised tools: - Patient record retrieval from healthcare systems - Clinical guideline matching for procedure-diagnosis pairs - Compliance validation against clinical criteria - Escalation decision-making based on quality scores - Evidence-based care plan recommendations - Leverage Oracle Integration's Agentic AI framework to register integrations as tools, configure thinking patterns (ReAct, Plan and Execute), and build intelligent agents - Enable Model Context Protocol (MCP) to expose your integrations as discoverable tools for external agent frameworks like Langflow and other AI platforms - Gain hands-on experience creating an end-to-end AI agent that conducts comprehensive quality audits, validates guideline adherence, determines escalation requirements, and generates actionable audit reports - Learn to monitor agent reasoning, validate decision-making, and troubleshoot agent behavior through Oracle Integration's observability features

Owner GroupDB Product Management
Short DescriptionThis lab guides users through essential steps for migrating data to Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB), covering how to connect, readiness checks, migration tools, performance analysis, and hands-on data movement exercises using Data Pump over NFS and DB Link methods.
Long DescriptionThis comprehensive lab is designed to provide hands-on experience with migrating on-premises databases to Oracle Autonomous Database (ADB) on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Participants will develop foundational knowledge of ADB architecture, its core capabilities, and the best practices for secure and efficient migrations. The lab begins by demonstrating how to establish secure and reliable connections to ADB, ensuring users are equipped to interact with the cloud database environment. Next, users will perform readiness checks on their existing environments, verifying all prerequisites—such as network connectivity, database and schema requirements, and necessary tools—are in place for a smooth migration. The lab walks participants through Oracle’s Cloud Migration Analyzer, a utility that scans your source database and offers tailored recommendations on the optimal migration strategy. Users will also measure and evaluate network latency between their systems and ADB to verify adherence to Oracle’s best practices for a successful migration. For actual data movement, the lab provides step-by-step guidance on exporting source data using Oracle Data Pump and importing it into ADB, using NFS. In addition, participants will explore migrating data using the DB Link method for direct transfers, giving users practical experience with multiple migration paths. After performing data migration tasks, the lab concludes with exercises that teach users how to monitor ADB’s performance, utilize troubleshooting tools, and analyze workload metrics to ensure the migrated environment operates efficiently. Throughout the lab, users gain valuable skills in planning, executing, and validating ADB migrations, preparing them for real-world cloud adoption scenarios.

Short DescriptionRAG application development with AI Vector Search in Autonomous Database. This time using APEX and your favorite LLM. Also uses OCI Object Storage as the secure document repository.
Long DescriptionIn this Oracle Live Labs workshop, participants will develop an advanced APEX application that integrates the Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) model with Oracle's cutting-edge AI and database technologies. Utilizing the ONNX framework and AI Vector capabilities within Oracle Autonomous Database 26AI, this application revolutionizes document management by enabling secure storage, vectorization, and advanced querying of documents stored in Oracle Cloud Object Storage. Users will interact with the application to ask complex questions, receiving precise, context-aware responses based on the vectorized contents of the documents they want to interact with. This workshop provides a deep dive into Oracle’s AI-driven capabilities, equipping participants with the skills to build next-generation applications that merge AI with enterprise data management for enhanced efficiency, security, and insight.

Short Description3 easy steps: Choose a Cloud Native Infrastructure, Frontend, Backend, DB / Download / Build. Using OCI Starter (opensource tool), choose - x86, ARM - VM, Kubernetes, Container Instance, Function - HTML, ReactJS, Angular, JET, APEX - Backend: Java (SpringBoot, Helidon, Tomcat, Micronaut), NodeJS, Python, .Net, Go, ORDS - DB: Oracle, ATP, 23c Free, MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL, OpenSearch
Long Description3 easy steps to create a Cloud Application using OCI Starter (opensource tool) - Choose your preferred cloud native components - Download the zip - And run build.sh The sample will be fully functional. You may choose from the below components: - Shape: x86 (AMD), ARM (Ampere), Free Tier (AMD) - Infrastructure: Compute (=Virtual Machine), Instance Pool (=several Vitual Machines), Kubernetes, Container Instance or Serverless Functions, - User interface: HTML, ReactJS, Angular, JET or APEX - Backend: Java, NodeJS, Python, Dotnet, Go or ORDS - For Java Frameworks: SpringBoot, Helidon, Micronaut or Tomcat - Database: Oracle DB, ATP, PDB, Oracle Database 23c Free, MySQL, PostgreSQ, NoSQL or OpenSearch - Infrastructure as Code: Terraform or Resource Manager The labs 6/7/8 explains how to customize the created sample. Then advanced features like: - GraalVM Native. - TLS (OCI Certificates, ACME/Letsencrypt DNS-01/HTTP-01/Kubernetes cert-manager) - Reuse existing resources - ...

Short DescriptionMonitor and safeguard databases with real-time activity tracking, advanced threat detection, and Database Security Posture Management (DSPM). Ensure continuous protection of sensitive data, detect risks early, enforce access controls, and help organizations stay compliant and secure against evolving threats.
Long DescriptionIn the era of digital transformation and heightened regulatory expectations, data security is no longer optional—it is a vital necessity. Oracle Audit Vault and Database Firewall (AVDF) is a robust solution that empowers organizations to safeguard their most valuable digital assets from both internal and external threats. With AVDF, your databases are protected through advanced auditing, real-time monitoring, and proactive defense mechanisms, all managed from a unified, streamlined interface. Why Attend this LiveLab? Do you worry about meeting complex compliance mandates such as PCI DSS, SOX, or GDPR? Are you tasked with defending your organization against sophisticated cyber threats while enabling business agility? This hands-on LiveLab is the perfect environment for data professionals, security administrators, and auditors to experience first-hand how AVDF helps organizations secure sensitive information, streamline compliance, and respond rapidly to suspicious activity—before damage is done. What Problem Does AVDF Solve? Modern database environments are highly dynamic and increasingly targeted by cyber attackers. Insiders with privileged access often represent the greatest risk, whether through error or deliberate misuse. Traditional logging and monitoring solutions frequently fall short—missing subtle policy violations or producing overwhelming volumes of raw data that are hard to interpret and act upon. Furthermore, regulatory auditors demand immediate, centralized, and immutable proof of how sensitive data is accessed and who is responsible. AVDF bridges these gaps by: - Centralizing and automating the collection, consolidation, and analysis of audit data from Oracle and non-Oracle databases. - Delivering real-time monitoring and alerts to detect unusual or unauthorized SQL activity—down to the individual statement. - Enforcing fine-grained controls at the network edge with the Database Firewall, blocking unwanted or suspicious commands before they can cause harm. - Offering a rich suite of compliance-ready reports and dashboards for continuous assurance. What You’ll Experience in this LiveLab In this interactive session, you'll step into the shoes of a security analyst or compliance officer as you: - Deploy and configure AVDF for both Oracle and non-Oracle database environments - Set up real-time auditing policies and analyze collected data through intuitive dashboards - Use the Database Firewall to enforce strong security controls, detect policy violations, and block malicious SQL traffic - Respond to simulated threats, generate compliance reports, and implement best practices for the separation of duties With guided exercises and real-world scenarios, you’ll gain practical skills you can immediately apply to your organization’s security and compliance strategy. No prior AVDF experience is required—just a willingness to learn and a desire to witness the power of Oracle’s database security solutions. Who Should Attend? - Database Administrators - Security Engineers - Auditors and Compliance Officers - IT Managers and Risk Professionals Whether you are wrestling with stricter compliance mandates, tightening your security posture, or just curious about next-generation database protection, this LiveLab will inspire you to rethink what’s possible with AVDF. Take the next step in your data security journey—join us for the AVDF LiveLab and unlock the tools to secure your enterprise database estates, meet compliance demands with confidence, and fend off the threats of tomorrow. Your path to resilient database defense starts here.

Short DescriptionExplore options for connecting your on-premises databases to Oracle Data Safe.
Long DescriptionWith Oracle Data Safe, you can protect all your Oracle databases, whether in the cloud or on-premises, with a consistent set of security features; the only difference is how Data Safe connects to your databases in a secure and reliable manner. This workshop walks you through the simple, one-time network setup that gives the same visibility and protection across all your Oracle databases. We’ll demonstrate two connectivity options: (1) the Data Safe private endpoint for Oracle databases running in a private virtual cloud network (VCN) within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) or for your databases connected via FastConnect or VPNConnect configured between your network and OCI; (2) and, the Data Safe on-premises connector for Oracle databases outside of OCI without either of those two network connections. Once your database is connected, you can explore all the key capabilities of Data Safe through the 'Get Started with Oracle Data Safe Fundamentals' LiveLab, ideal for DBAs and cloud architects looking to streamline and scale database security.

Short DescriptionThis workshop showcases how AI Agents in Oracle APEX streamline inventory and warehouse management through conversational automation. Users can identify stock shortages, evaluate supplier options, review delivery performance, and create purchase orders quickly without navigating multiple reports, improving supply chain efficiency and decision-making.
Long DescriptionManaging stock shortages and supplier decisions manually takes time that warehouse teams do not always have. When an item drops below its reorder point and the replenishment alert is already CRITICAL, a warehouse manager needs answers fast: which items are at risk, which suppliers can help, and who has the best delivery record. AI Agents in Oracle APEX give your application the ability to reason through these questions and act on the answers. Instead of navigating multiple reports and forms, a user can open a chat panel and have a guided conversation. The agent understands who the user is, retrieves the right data, compares options, asks for confirmation, and raises a purchase order, all without leaving the application. This workshop focuses on the inventory and warehouse management aspects of supply chain: identifying stock shortages, evaluating supplier options, and raising purchase orders through a conversational AI Agent. In this hands-on workshop, you will build an AI Procurement Agent for the APEX Inventory and Warehouse Management application. You will define tools that allow warehouse managers to identify stock shortages, evaluate suppliers, and raise purchase orders, all from within a conversational chat interface in Oracle APEX. You will define eight tools using the three tool types available in APEX AI Agents: Retrieve Data, Execute Server-side Code, and Execute Client-side Code. You will also learn when to use each one, all configured declaratively within Oracle APEX.

Short DescriptionLearn how to configure your Autonomous AI Database as an MCP server and use it with Select AI Agent-defined tools. This MCP server is a fully managed Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Autonomous AI Database Serverless.
Long DescriptionLearn how to configure your Autonomous AI Database as an MCP server and use it in combination with Select AI Agent-defined tools. This MCP server is a fully managed Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Autonomous AI Database Serverless. There is no customer-hosted MCP infrastructure required and enables immediate integration with MCP-compatible clients (Claude desktop, OCI AI Agent, etc.). You can enable AI apps to interact with ADB features without custom glue code, while using secure access through Database Identity and OAuth2.1-based Identity providers (Entra ID, Okta, etc.). Being part of the database, the MCP server provides enterprise governance, auditing, and policy enforcement (ACL/PE, VPD, audit logs, rate limits). The MCP server supports 19c and 26ai databases.

Short DescriptionThis workshop will guide you through how to set up and use Java Management Service (JMS) on OCI
Long DescriptionThis workshop is designed to guide you through the setup and utilization of Java Management Service (JMS) on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Initially, it covers the setup process, including creating essential OCI resources like Tagging, User Groups, Dynamic Groups, and Policies needed to initiate JMS functionality. Subsequently, it provides a step-by-step guide on creating a fleet, which serves as the primary collection for JMS operations and encompasses Managed Instances with a unified management approach. Following this, it walks you through creating a simple Java Application on an OCI compute instance or Windows OS. You'll then learn how to configure the Management Agent on your local machine (referred to as a Managed Instance in JMS) to monitor your Java application and view it within a fleet in JMS. Later, the workshop will cover the installation and configuration of the Management Gateway on an on-premises host, enabling another on-premises host to proxy through it for communication with the OCI network and JMS. Furthermore, it introduces the setup of a Java Application in a Docker container for monitoring using JMS. Finally, it will offer guidance on downloading Java artifacts via JMS and utilizing script-friendly URLs for monitoring Java downloads.

Short DescriptionIn this workshop, you learn to integrate Oracle APEX with OCI Document Understanding, highlighting steps to incorporate these technologies seamlessly into your workflow.
Long DescriptionIn the digital transformation era, businesses constantly seek innovative solutions to enhance their processes and maximize efficiency. Oracle APEX and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Document Understanding have emerged as powerful tools to streamline data extraction and processing. In this workshop, you learn to integrate Oracle APEX with OCI Document Understanding, highlighting steps to incorporate these technologies seamlessly into your workflow. Within this user-friendly app built with the Oracle APEX low-code platform, users effortlessly upload invoices by selecting the "Select an Invoice or Receipt" option. OCI Document Understanding then extracts form fields from the uploaded image or PDF file. With this functionality, users can streamline their expense management process with ease. Once your document is processed, you will easily transition to a user-friendly page featuring the Cards Region, which displays critical information in an organized manner. Clicking on a card brings up a Pop-up Dialog page where you will find a clear comparison between your uploaded PDF and the output from OCI Document Understanding.

Long DescriptionMigrate a WebLogic Server domain from on-premises to WebLogic Server on OKE provisioned with the Marketplace. This workshop will guide you through the end-to-end migration of a WebLogic domain, along with the application database, to WebLogic on OKE. In this workshop, you will migrate a WebLogic domain with its applications and resources to Oracle Kubernetes Engine using a simulated on-premises environment. Provision the Weblogic Server on OKE and CI/CD infrastructure with the Marketplace and the Application Database on OCI Autonomous Database. Then, migrate the database from on-premises using data pump and the Weblogic domain applications and resources with Weblogic Deploy Tooling and Jenkins. Finally, tear down the environment.

Short DescriptionIn this lab, participants will explore the integration of Oracle APEX with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services to create a powerful, AI-driven solution for quickly accessing and analyzing relevant information. This workshop is ideal for technical professionals looking to enhance their expertise in developing smart applications that can extract insights.
Long DescriptionIn this hands-on lab, participants will explore the powerful integration of Oracle APEX and Oracle AI services, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and Large Language Models (LLMs), to create a seamless, AI-driven solution designed for document management and analysis. Participants will learn how to build applications that enable users to interact with documents via chat, allowing them to quickly analyze, extract valuable insights, and easily upload documents to Oracle Cloud services, such as Object Storage. The lab will guide participants through the process of integrating Oracle APEX as the front-end solution for building intuitive applications, while building a native chatbot for conversational AI capabilities. Users will interact with documents, asking natural language questions and receiving real-time responses, empowering them to extract key information quickly. Oracle AI, powered by LLMs, will be used to analyze uploaded documents, such as financial reports, press releases, and news articles, to deliver insights through advanced natural language processing. On the backend, participants will explore how Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI services and Autonomous Database can be used to process and analyze the documents stored in Oracle Cloud, applying pre-built AI models to extract relevant insights. The AI models will be trained to identify key information within documents, such as sentiment, financial highlights, and important trends, helping users make data-driven decisions faster.

Short DescriptionOracle Deep Data Security is a database-native access control system in Oracle AI Database 26ai that enforces fine-grained, identity-aware data access policies directly in the database. It ensures users and AI agents can only see and modify the data they’re authorized to—down to the row, column, or cell level—based on their identity and context, without relying on application code.
Long DescriptionOracle Deep Data Security is a database-native access control system that enforces fine-grained, identity-aware data access for users and AI agents. It enables least-privilege access down to the row, column, and cell level using declarative SQL policies (data grants), which are evaluated and enforced inside the database at runtime based on the end-user’s identity, roles, and context—ensuring that only authorized data is ever retrieved, regardless of the query or application.

Short DescriptionSecure data access at the source with Microsoft Entra ID and Oracle Deep Data Security. Map app roles to database data roles and enforce row- and column-level policies per user—no code, no proxies. Same query, different results, automatically enforced by the database.
Long DescriptionOracle AI Database 26ai Deep Data Security solves AI agent security within the kernel of the database. With Deep Data Security, there are no proxies to route traffic through, no agents on the operating system to manage, nothing that bolts on to the database. The controls are declarative, identity-aware, and enforced before data ever leaves the database engine. The agent never sees restricted data — it physically cannot be retrieved. Guardrails protect the conversation; data grants protect the data itself. Your security team gets a control they can verify, and your AI project gets unblocked.
